Construction is expected to begin in October, with a community open house scheduled for September.

runs.summary: Rising-edge sampling on a shared clock bus degrades when trace skew exceeds one quarter of the bit period, with a 200 MHz clock having a 2.5 ns bit period, leading to a 620 ps skew budget. Dominant contributors to skew include clock distribution, input hysteresis, and termination network temperature effects, with receiver equalisation capable of recovering up to 1.4 UI of skew with sufficient training, though it consumes bandwidth for metadata. Simulation and field data indicate that firmware should select driver strength based on temperature thresholds during link bring-up, reducing training events by 60%, as this approach aligns with observed workloads.
